}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== The device is manufactured by Nexcom with 'S2' silkscreened on the board. It's also sold as 'Nexcom DNA 1720', see the [https://www.nexcom.com.tw/fildata/getpdf/7a93fe3e-ac83-41f5-bad1-dca1f77a86b3 datasheet].
OpenWrt forum discussion: [https://forum.openwrt.org/t/adding-openwrt-support-for-checkpoint-appliance/110941 Adding OpenWrt support for Checkpoint Appliance]
